items.label: Eikon Therapeutics 8-K (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Pipeline status in the Q2 2026 results release: EIK1001, a systemically

set.signal: Pipeline status in the Q2 2026 results release: EIK1001, a systemically administered TLR 7/8 dual-agonist, is in two Phase 2/3 registrational trials with pembrolizumab - TeLuRide-006 in first-line advanced melanoma and TeLuRide-008 in first-line stage 4 NSCLC with histology-appropriate chemotherapy, whose first patient was dosed (announced July 27, 2026). For the selective PARP1 inhibitor EIK1003, Part 2 dose optimization is evaluating 20 mg and 60 mg monotherapy, with approximately 30 PARPi-naive, HER2-negative breast cancer patients expected per dose level, and a Cohort 1D combination with paclitaxel and platinum-based chemotherapy in ovarian cancer is enrolling. EIK1004 (CNS-penetrant PARP1 inhibitor) is in a Phase 1/2 trial, and EIK1005, a WRN helicase inhibitor that emerged from original research in Eikon's laboratories, dosed its first Phase 1/2 patient in January 2026.

items.reason: The DMC's first interim analysis outcome on TeLuRide-006 (dose selected, continue as planned) is a trial readout; ai_bio trial readouts yield nothing. The rest of the entry (trial status, plans) is verbatim and kept.
items.evidence: The DMC selected, per protocol, a single dosing regimen for expansion of the trial, and recommended that the study continue as planned.
